items.title: Intermittent segfault in @duckdb/node-api test on debian 13 x64 CI (release build)
items.body:
### What happened?

`test/js/third_party/@duckdb/node-api/duckdb.test.ts` segfaulted on the `debian 13 x64` CI shard in two consecutive builds of the same PR branch (#32089):

- [Build 61927](https://buildkite.com/bun/bun/builds/61927) at b116124e0f: `Segmentation fault at address 0x1E128000`, crash report `l_2b116124gmEikggCi7++C_A2Agggqie`
- [Build 61931](https://buildkite.com/bun/bun/builds/61931) at 36adfc019d: `Segmentation fault at address 0x117D5000`, crash report https://bun.report/1.4.0/l_236adfc0gmEikggCi7++C_A2Aggo1vR

Both crashes happen ~1.5s into the file after roughly 5 passing tests, in the release (`bun-profile`) build. The parsed trace has a single unresolvable frame in `bun` (address 1555889 in build 61927; remap failed in CI). The fault addresses are page-aligned, which looks like a read past the end of a heap mapping.

### Why I do not think the PR branch causes it

- The commits between the last duckdb-green build of the branch ([61890](https://buildkite.com/bun/bun/builds/61890)) and the first crash touch only `src/js/internal/sql/postgres.ts`, `packages/bun-types/sql.d.ts`, `docs/runtime/sql.mdx`, and `test/js/sql/sql.test.ts`. The postgres adapter module is never loaded by the duckdb test (its loaded builtins per the crash banner: `bun:internal-for-testing`, `bun:jsc`, `bun:test`, `node:assert`, `node:child_process`, `node:fs`, `node:os`, `node:path`).
- The failing shard did not run `test/js/sql/sql.test.ts` at all; the files preceding duckdb in the job were node parallel/zlib/tls tests.
- 20 consecutive local runs of the exact test with a release-profile build at the same commit (36adfc019d, Linux x64, glibc) pass in ~350ms each with zero crashes.
- No duckdb failure appears in the last 12 main builds or 8 recent builds of other branches.

That leaves a latent, load- or layout-sensitive crash in the `@duckdb/node-bindings` NAPI path (or Bun's NAPI layer) that the branch happens to tickle, likely via binary layout shift (the branch adds ~16 KB of code) or CI runner memory pressure (the test machine reports 8.17 GB with parallel shards). Related history: #29340 (closed) was a duckdb segfault in the raw npm addon.

### Reproduction

Not reproducible locally so far. CI-only, 2 out of 2 recent runs on one branch, 0 elsewhere.
